cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I broke your graduation mug. Put the pieces down; I'll clear them. Losing it is how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the handle while you glue. See how hard we're finding this? We needed that break.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take mine. I'll use a jam jar; losing it will do me good.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs cleanup and frames loss as learning; A3 accommodates gluing while insisting the break was needed; A5 gives A own mug and keeps the lesson applied to A too.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 broken B mug and A3 repair help are compatible; B4 requests an intact replacement and A5 alone switches to a jar.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the sentimental object repaired and B4 asks A to bear a concrete equivalent cost.

heightening.evidence: B4 demand moves the growth claim onto A own attachment, causing A5 a real concession rather than further advice.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies responsibility and the graduation mug; B4 supplies the matching personal stake for A.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 replacement, A own drinking alternative and belief the loss will help form one response to B4, without imposing a contradictory plan on B.
